name: nowen-forge
description: Unified build and release console for the Nowen ecosystem

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @nowen-forge/server" "npm run dev -w @nowen-forge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nowen-forge/web && npm run build -w @nowen-forge/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nowen-forge/web && npm run typecheck -w @nowen-forge/server
